videos.desc: POV of a traveler scanning her boarding pass at the airport gate, walking down the glass jet bridge, being greeted by a flight attendant at the plane door, moving along the cabin aisle and settling happily into her seat by the window.
videos.said: I board the plane. I show my ticket and walk to my seat.

videos.desc: In a 3D-animated holiday scene a young woman lounges in a rope hammock strung above a blue-domed island view, swaying gently while she reads; the netting and its ropes frame her through the whole clip.

An animated couple enjoys a holiday on a big white cruise ship: they wave from the deck with cocktails, relax on sun loungers by the pool, the ship sails past tropical islands with dolphins, and they walk down the gangway onto a beach.

In a hand-painted border hall, a girl in a yellow coat puts her suitcase on the customs counter; the officer asks if she has anything to declare, digs through her clothes and pulls out a huge spiky durian, which ends up in a metal bin before he chalks an X on her suitcase and lets her through.
videos.said: Anything to declare? Just fruit. One fruit! Not this one. Sorry.

videos.desc: In an animated night-time bus station, a driver blocks the bus door telling waiting passengers with suitcases 'not yet'. A large clock's hands spin forward while a blonde woman in a red coat waits, throws up her arms in frustration, and finally lies collapsed on her suitcase in the rain with the other passengers still waiting.
videos.said: Sorry, not yet! Aw, come on!

videos.desc: A group of friends with backpacks loads into a minibus and rides through green sheep-dotted countryside, pointing out the window. They park, hike a woodland path to a big waterfall and pose together for a phone group photo in front of it.

Two animated tourists sit on the steps of a lion fountain flipping through a thick travel book of photos; they match the lion fountain on the page to the real one behind them, then point at the Leaning Tower page and run off to find it, book under arm.
videos.said: What is this one? That one! Look! Same! Now, the big tower.

videos.desc: A 3D-animated backpacker gets a room key at a small reception desk, climbs the stairs into a dorm full of bunk beds and other travelers, claims a free top bunk for ten euros, shares crisps with a bunk neighbor and later toasts mugs with the whole room.
videos.said: Is this bed free? Yes! Take the top! Perfect! 10 euros! Welcome! We all share!

videos.desc: In an animated night forest, a young woman with a lantern walks in front of a group of hikers, telling them to step where she steps; she leads them across stepping stones in a stream and up a path to a glowing valley view.
videos.said: Follow me is it safe step where I step Okay

videos.desc: A smiling girl in a life jacket dips a wooden paddle into a calm green river and strokes on both sides of a canoe, gliding past bamboo and orange cliffs. A man in a sun hat lies dozing in the bow and gets a few drips on his face as she paddles over him.

In a Ghibli-style anime Venice, a tourist couple with a camera admires the bell tower and pigeons on a grand square, points at a domed cathedral, then rides a gondola under a bridge along the canals taking photos of the sights.

In a Ghibli-style anime, a woman with a rolling suitcase walks through sliding doors into a vast glass airport terminal, passes the check-in counters, rides an escalator and watches planes on the runway through the huge windows.

A cartoon woman in a green jumpsuit and headwrap stands on a sunny boardwalk, grips the pole of a striped beach umbrella and tilts it over so the shade covers her deck chair, then settles back into the chair with a satisfied "Better."

A young man ties his boots by an alpine chalet, hikes up a forest trail over tree roots, reaches a viewpoint above a turquoise mountain lake, takes a happy selfie and then sits on a rocky ledge eating fruit while looking over the valley.

A young woman in a yellow bikini steps under an outdoor shower on a wooden beach boardwalk, the sea and white sand behind her. She rinses the seawater off, running her hands through her wet hair while she talks to the camera about how good the shower feels.
videos.said: Okay, this shower is actually the best part of the beach.

videos.desc: A first-person view looks down from the bow of a wooden sailing ship at the planking and rigging beneath, with the viewer's boots on the boards and loose pack ice drifting in the dark water either side. The camera lifts to a huge pale blue iceberg passing the varnished rail, then to snow-covered mountains mirrored in the flat polar sea.

A travel sequence in thick mist. A man in a teal jacket stands on a windswept grassy hilltop swinging a big white sheet through the fog. Then a point-of-view shot looks down at a pair of orange trainers standing at the top of a long, narrow stone stairway that runs straight down the ridge and disappears into the cloud, with a huge rock pillar looming ahead. Next, an empty road runs between two rows of golden ginkgo trees towards a red pagoda under a cliff. In the last shot the man, now with a blue rucksack, walks away up a narrow dirt path worn through the green grass, past a wooden handrail, climbing towards the fog-covered rock tower above.

A travel sequence. Five young men in swimming shorts lie side by side on their backs on the low heather and grass beside a still forest lake, feet towards the camera, resting in the sun with dark pine trees on the far shore. The next shot shows friends lying stretched out in long grass on a hillside high above a patchwork of green fields, only their heads and knees showing above the grass. Then a point-of-view shot looks down a long red wooden staircase dropping down a green cliff towards a turquoise bay and a white beach far below. In the last shot the camera sits in the grass at the top of a cliff, legs stretched out in front, looking across at a wide waterfall pouring into a gorge under an orange sunset sky.

A first-person shot shows two gloved hands holding leather reins that run to a seagull flying just ahead, harnessed like a horse. The gull carries the camera over a huge suspension bridge half lost in fog, then drops down and races along a narrow strip of green water between two big red cargo ships tied up at a dock. It skims through the spray, and finally levels out over the harbour towards a white lighthouse with a city skyline behind it.
videos.said: Ready, my friend? It's my first time. Okay, easy, easy. No more tricks. Take me to the tower.

videos.desc: A long concrete aqueduct wall runs through a jungle of tall palm trees, with water spilling over its edge as a wide waterfall. Young men lie on their backs in the shallow water on top of the concrete channel and slide along it with their arms flung out, throwing up spray. They then stand under the falling water at the foot of the wall, the white torrent pouring over their heads and shoulders. A drone shot pulls back to show the whole mossy wall, the sheet of falling water and one man still sliding along the top, surrounded by green jungle.

A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.

A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.

A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.

A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.

A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.
videos.said: My friends bury me in the sand! Only my head is out.

videos.desc: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.

A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.
